
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/halfcode/p/23586879" title="发布于 2026-11-07 19:43">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">15. ArkTS类型转换的 6 个坑，90% 的人都踩过</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>布尔值转成字符串，三种写法，结果一样。<code>String()</code> 最直接。加空字符串最省事。<code>toString()</code> 是方法调用。</p>
<p>动画视频在《<a class="name ellipsis" href="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1Qr4E63EzU/" target="_blank" data-v-3995fb7c="" rel="noopener nofollow">ArkTS类型转换的 6 个坑，90% 的人都踩过</a>》。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>let isOpen: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">boolean</span> = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
let isClose: </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">boolean</span> = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

let s1: string </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> String(isOpen);
console.log(s1, </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">typeof</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> s1);

let s2: string </span>= isClose + ''<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
console.log(s2, </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">typeof</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> s2);

let s3: string </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> isOpen.toString();
console.log(s3, </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">typeof</span> s3);</pre>
</div>
<p><code>true</code> 变成 <code>"true"</code>，<code>false</code> 变成 <code>"false"</code>。<code>typeof</code> 都是 <code>"string"</code>。</p>
<p>先开启预览器，再打开日志面板，按 Ctrl + S 保存，才能看到输出。后面的 <code>console.log</code> 也一样。</p>
<h2>数字转字符串</h2>
<p>整数也是这三种。小数要控制位数时，用 <code>toFixed</code>。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>let num: number = 42<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
let price: number </span>= 9.99<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

console.log(String(num), </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">typeof</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> String(num));
console.log(num </span>+ '', <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">typeof</span> (num + ''<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">));
console.log(num.toString(), </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">typeof</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> num.toString());

console.log(price.toFixed(</span>1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">));
console.log((</span>0.1 + 0.2).toFixed(2));</pre>
</div>
<p><code>42</code> 三种都得到 <code>"42"</code>，类型是 <code>"string"</code>。</p>
<p><code>toFixed</code> 返回的是字符串，并且会四舍五入。<code>9.99</code> 保留 1 位小数，第二位是 9，进位之后是 <code>"10.0"</code>。<code>0.1 + 0.2</code> 在计算机里不是干净的 0.3，<code>toFixed(2)</code> 得到 <code>"0.30"</code>。金额要留几位小数，用它收一下。</p>
<div>
<p><img alt="价格9.99" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202611/1919157-20261107193945613-2100721351.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2>字符串转数字</h2>
<p><code>Number()</code> 最严。整串都得是数字，夹了别的字符就得到 <code>NaN</code>。空字符串是个例外，转出来是 <code>0</code>。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>let strNum: string = '123'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
let strFloat: string </span>= '3.14'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
let strMix: string </span>= '12px'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

console.log(</span>"strNum ="<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, Number(strNum));
console.log(</span>"strFloat ="<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, Number(strFloat));
console.log(</span>"strMix ="<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, Number(strMix));
console.log(</span>"空字符串 =", Number(''<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">));
console.log(</span>"abc =", Number('abc'));</pre>
</div>
<p><code>'123'</code> 是 123，<code>'3.14'</code> 是 3.14。<code>'12px'</code> 和 <code>'abc'</code> 是 <code>NaN</code>。空字符串是 0。</p>
<p><code>parseInt</code> 只留整数。从左边读，碰到不能当数字的字符就停。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>console.log("parseInt(strFloat) ="<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, parseInt(strFloat));
console.log(</span>"parseInt(strMix) =", parseInt(strMix));</pre>
</div>
<p><code>'3.14'</code> 得到 3。<code>'12px'</code> 读到 <code>px</code> 停下，得到 12。</p>
<p><code>parseFloat</code> 会把小数留下，碰到不能继续读的字符同样停下。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>console.log("parseFloat(strFloat) ="<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, parseFloat(strFloat));
console.log(</span>"parseFloat(strMix) =", parseFloat(strMix));</pre>
</div>
<p><code>'3.14'</code> 得到 3.14。<code>'12px'</code> 还是 12。</p>
<p>整串必须是数字，用 <code>Number()</code>。要从一串文字里把数字抠出来，用 <code>parseInt</code> 或 <code>parseFloat</code>。拿不准就用 <code>Number()</code>，失败会得到 <code>NaN</code>，能看出来。</p>
<h2>字符串转布尔</h2>
<p><code>Boolean()</code> 和两个感叹号 <code>!!</code> 是同一条规则。空字符串是 <code>false</code>，非空字符串都是 <code>true</code>。里面写的是 <code>'false'</code> 还是 <code>'0'</code>，不影响。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>console.log("Boolean('') =", Boolean(''<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">));
console.log(</span>"Boolean('false') =", Boolean('false'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">));
console.log(</span>"Boolean('0') =", Boolean('0'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">));
console.log(</span>"Boolean(' ') =", Boolean(' '<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">));
console.log(</span>"Boolean('hello') =", Boolean('hello'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">));

console.log(</span>"!!'false' =", !!'false'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
console.log(</span>"!!'' =", !!'');</pre>
</div>
<p>空字符串是 <code>false</code>。<code>'false'</code>、<code>'0'</code>、一个空格、<code>'hello'</code> 都是 <code>true</code>。空格也算有字符。<code>!!'false'</code> 同样是 <code>true</code>，<code>!!''</code> 是 <code>false</code>。</p>
<p><img alt="字符串false" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202611/1919157-20261107194139663-1387143929.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2>转换前先看类型</h2>
<p>直接转，失败就是 <code>NaN</code>。先看类型，再转，再检查结果。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>let input: string = '123'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
let bad: string </span>= 'abc'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

console.log(</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">typeof</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> input);
console.log(</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">typeof</span> 123<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
console.log(</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">typeof</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span>);</pre>
</div>
<p><code>typeof</code> 返回的是字符串：<code>"string"</code>、<code>"number"</code>、<code>"boolean"</code>。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>let n1: number =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Number(input);
let n2: number </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Number(bad);

console.log(</span>"Number.isNaN(n1) ="<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, Number.isNaN(n1));
console.log(</span>"Number.isNaN(n2) ="<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, Number.isNaN(n2));

console.log(</span>"Number.isFinite(n1) ="<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, Number.isFinite(n1));
console.log(</span>"Number.isFinite(n2) ="<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, Number.isFinite(n2));
console.log(</span>"Number.isFinite(Infinity) =", Number.isFinite(Infinity));</pre>
</div>
<p><code>'123'</code> 转出来不是 <code>NaN</code>，<code>Number.isNaN(n1)</code> 是 <code>false</code>。<code>'abc'</code> 转出来是 <code>NaN</code>，<code>Number.isNaN(n2)</code> 是 <code>true</code>。</p>
<p><code>Number.isFinite</code> 看它是不是一个有限的数。<code>n1</code> 是 <code>true</code>。<code>NaN</code> 和 <code>Infinity</code> 都是 <code>false</code>。</p>
<p>判断一个字符串能不能转成数字：先 <code>Number()</code>，再用 <code>Number.isNaN()</code> 看结果。</p>
</div>

</div>
